properties.description: State after sending REGISTRATION REQUEST, waiting for response or T3510 expiry.
Registered but only limited service allowed (e.g., due to CAG restrictions).
Registered but required to perform PLMN selection (e.g., due to CAG restrictions).
Deregistered, attempting registration after a failure or T3510 expiry (counter < 5), or waiting for T3502/T3346 expiry.
Deregistered, required to perform PLMN/SNPN selection due to specific rejection causes or counter expiry.
Deregistered, only limited service possible due to specific rejection causes (e.g., TA not allowed).
Deregistered because UE or ME is considered illegal, or 5GS services not allowed, or PEI not accepted.
Deregistered and required to search for E-UTRAN cell due to redirection.
Represents the event of triggering the Mobility Registration Update procedure, aborting the current one.
Represents the event of triggering the UE Initiated De-registration procedure, aborting the current one.
Triggered by conditions in 5.5.1.2.2 a-g, or after T3511/T3502/T3346 expiry.
Timer expiry for a specific S-NSSAI rejected due to max UEs.
